d: In this video, we provide a step-by-step guide to help salaried taxpayers file their ITR-1 online in as little as 10 minutes using the Income Tax e-Filing portal. We cover the entire filing process; from logging in and verifying personal details to reviewing pre-filled information from Form 16 and AIS, choosing the appropriate tax regime, reporting salary income and TDS details, claiming eligible deductions, verifying the tax calculation, and submitting the return.
